title: Incident at Nellis Area 2 weapon storage
place_text: Nellis Air Force Base, Nevada, Area 2

tellings.quote: another incident occurred at the Nellis Air Force Base Nevada area 2 weapon storage area

plain: Another UFO incident took place at the Area 2 weapons storage area of Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, where military weapons are kept. The researcher Robert Hastings, who collects accounts of UFOs over nuclear and weapons sites, mentions it in a list of such cases without giving a date or details. He tells it as part of a pattern of UFOs showing interest in places where weapons are stored.
